content: अनुकल्पः An alternative, a second alternative, a make-shift, अभावे हि श्रुतस्य अनुकम्पः प्रतिनिधिः . <ls>ŚB. on MS. 6. 3. 35</ls>.

अनुकल्पः [अनुगतः मुख्यं कल्पम्] .²1 A secondary direction or precept, a substitute or alternative to be used in times of necessity when the primary one (प्रथमकल्प) is not possible; as the direction to use गोधूम or तण्डुल in the absence of यव; प्रभुः प्रथमकल्पस्य योऽनुकल्पेन वर्तते <ls>Ms. 11. 30</ls>, <ls n="Ms.">3. 147</ls>. .²2 A work connected with Kalpa (one of the six auxiliaries of the Vedas).
